name: FIN13 Case 2
desc: Attack flow for the FIN13 campaign targeting a bank in Peru.

acts.d: Exploited the Log4j vulnerability to open a breach head on the DMZ
The attacker immediately deployed tools on the breached DMZ
Moved laterally to a DMZ segment hosting a SharePoint server probably by using a RCE vulnerability.
Succesfully dumped the SharePoint cached credentials and sent the files to a Dropzone to crack offline.
Executed a scan on the REMWK DMZ to find additional servers.
Attacker used RBMAdmin account to log into all databases on REMWK DMZ.
Attacker logged and queried all databases and dumped data containing user information.
A VBScript was identified on the system, which scanned system shares and output the result.
Multiple instances of PsExec was identified on the targeted DC. One instance was referenced in a bat script, which enabled RDP in four hosts.
Tested INTSRV machines to find one accessible from the Internet
Attacker accessed the V-Center server using previously stolen valid accounts
Attackers cloned one of the SecurID servers in the VMware center
Attacker exported the SecurID server image over the webshell on QTJPGPA1
